column1: # Decisions for the candidates tools/candidates.py lists from the game's data.
# One row per candidate, keyed by its cast spell ID (the base button when a talent or a
# PvP talent swaps it): spellID <TAB> in|out <TAB> the reason, in plain words.
# The rule each reason names: the tags of docs/PartyCD-classification.md (defense, burst,
# control, other) for `in`; for `out`: a cooldown under 30 s, movement only, rotational
# damage or healing, a taunt, a slow or root only (not control by the design), no aura on
# a player, or utility that does not decide an arena fight.
# Proposals (in, not in Spells.lua; out, but in Spells.lua) come out in docs/PartyCD-candidates.md.
